method: Independent source-informed design and public-interface review; not a cold human playtest
ownership: organizer/v4-quality* only; root owns live services and final staging
execution: Condev rowdy-impossible-dev; fresh full first-party staging and SHA-256 parity required before browser execution

design_assessment.q4: Explicit destruction of sole key K7 resolves ambiguous FORGET IT language while preserving archive-erasure reasoning.
design_assessment.q13: Use equally sized and equally dense pseudorandom badges with an ink-preserving delta. Keep presentation identical across options.
design_assessment.q16: Separate fixed original count 42/checksum 6 from editable revised count and computed readonly sum. Explain decimal digit addition without validity feedback.
design_assessment.q10_q17: Natural file properties must expose a full selectable SHA-256 before Eject. No automatic USB receipt, notebook artifact, recall control or retention hint. Source build numbers and meaningful release IDs could undermine the specifically requested hash-memory step.
design_assessment.q19: Eight hash-linked same-time records including five DENY events require causal ordering. Opaque IDs and display order must not encode chronology. Full PREV/hash/bytes must be reachable.
design_assessment.q20: Identify selected layer and current x/y/rotation; visibly explain ordinary add, remove, move and rotate controls. Verify real pixel changes and persistence.

live_checks_pending: Q10 complete selectable hash and natural access without retention hint
Q13 current badge visual density and real difference viewer
Q16 fixed versus computed checksum and leading-zero draft persistence
Q17 no automatic recalled artifact; wrong deployment costs two lives and shows angry goose; recovery works
Q19 unique causal chain, five DENY candidates, same clocks, paginated details and keyboard focus
Q20 add/select/remove controls, misalignment and rotation change actual pixels, cancel operation, drafts, keyboard focus and magnifier
limitations: Approved Hard–Very Hard rating is preserved; no independent human difficulty calibration is claimed.
No independent human playtesting, human listening, or anti-agent effectiveness assessment.
Current checkout has no Git repository metadata; source manifests identify revisions.
No service lifecycle changes or shared dependency installation by this reviewer.
